meta.homeTopicsRuleText: Home topics = the OpenAlex topics (all listed topics plus the assigned one) on Ken's lead (first / last / corresponding) papers, computed once. A citing work's distance d compares its assigned topic with that set: 0 home topic, 1 same subfield, 2 same field, 3 same domain, 4 another domain. Bands: core d 0, neighbour d 1–2, further d ≥ 3 or no topic. The All / Lead chip filters squares and shelf; it never recolours.
